review_text: My first pair of Jordan 1 Highs! These are very high-quality sneakers. My only real complaint is that the price is very steep. Otherwise, great sneakers that arrived in a timely manner and in pristine condition! The premium(?) leather is very crease-resistant. I don’t really mind creasing - I think of it as a badge of honor because it shows you wear your shoes - but I say that because I’ve worn them six times now and they still look fresh out the box! Plus, the suede is very easy to clean. (I got a drip of salsa on my drip, but a slightly damp paper towel followed up with a dry one cleared it right up and it looks like it never happened!) Definitely my favorite pair of sneakers. 10/10 highly recommend, especially for sneakerheads in training like me. :)

I received one real, authentic Jordan shoe and the other is fake! Please beware before purchasing from StockX. I would NOT recommend purchasing anything from this website. Both shoes were “certified” but you can distinctively see the color difference, the creases on one of the shoes and I cannot reach anyone. This is was supposed to be a present for my bf and I cannot gift him fake Jordan’s. Sent an email over a month ago and I have not heard back s from anyone. DO NOT recommend.

It was my first time using StockX and I was looking to purchase the coveted Jordan 1 Retro High in University Blue for my daughter's birthday. The link a friend sent me listed these as Men's size 7 shoes so I paid a premium price for these shoes. It wasn't until I received an email confirmation of the purchase that it said Toddler in the description, and there was no way to cancel/amend my order. I now have a very disappointed teenager plus own incredible overpriced pair of Toddler's size 7 sneakers.

review_title: Great Shoes. Well worth the price.
review_text: The haters have it all wrong. They are great shoes; both beautiful and stylish. They are only as shiny as a nicely polished pair of dress shoes. They fit true to size. I would NOT go one size up. My pair is true to size and I see no absolutely no evidence of creasing after wearing them. They are my favorite pair of shoes. They on par with my Nike Vapormax which I use for long walks and my Timberland boat shoes which I use if I am going to take a walk or a hike in wooded and grassy areas especially after a rain. To say it again, they are GREAT shoes.

Even though I spent more than 340euros my purchase was 100% worth it. The quality of the shoes are luxurious and despite having bought a size higher accidentally it is still by far my most comfortable shoes because I was able to just Tighten the laces. Jordan 1s are amazing and these are even better. They look amazing with almost every outfit. 10/10 recommend.

The product was descent but StockX did no offer anything for the huge crease in the back of one of the heels. If not an exchange a store credit would have been an acceptable compromise. StockX’s ability to offer great service or to compensate for any dissatisfaction is horrible. I have used another reseller at least four times since this purchase a few weeks ago. I will more than likely not use StockX again.

Awesome and different AJ1 , made up of different types of suede / nubuck material. I really like the different approach on a classic 1 Comes with 3 sets of laces. Black , white , black/orangish. Unusual color Union LA style laces somehow work. Has 3m reflective around the toe and sides of shoes. My favorite part is the quilted heel padding and insoles. Overall a really nice Jordan 1 .

Very disappointed, I ordered size 10 for men but I received size 10 for toddler. I was so shocked and disappointed. The rosy thing stockx doesn’t allow me to return it and won’t refund. My $450 down the drain since I have no toddler to share these shows with . Stockx you expect my ya and to wear toddler shoes ??? I would never buy it from stockx

review_title: Definitely one of my favorite Jordan 1 pickups this year.
review_text: Huge shout out to Finishline/JD Sports for the status rewards restock. Up until recently I had struck out on getting these. I took a L on the original release date and every single restock that followed but that Ls to Finishline I was able to finally grab my pair for retail. The transaction was smooth and flawless on the app when the restock happened. 250 points well spent in my book. I really wish more stores would restock their shoes this way. It really give the consumer a chance rather than letting bots eat up all of the restocked sneakers. I am beyond pleased and if I could give this review 1000 stars I would. These sneakers are beautiful in hand and once again, thank you Finishline/JD Sports for giving use humans a fighting chance. Much love and respect for that one.

Probably the most disappointing acquisition to my collection so far. Ive had shoes with factory flaws but the fact that eBays authenticators let the pair that I received pass for new without defects just baffles me. Theres scuffs & creases as well as plenty of glue stains that not only show that the shoe has been worn & is not indeed new without defects, but that they dont care about some of the smaller details & are perfectly willing to overlook them. A beautiful shoe built with quality materials but most are cursed with flaws from mishandling or Nike QC, or both like mine. Of course eBay doesnt exactly make it easier to weed these pairs out with their anything goes authentication process. Just ask for more pictures and information before hitting buy now or youll regret it.
